items.headline: Fluidstack raises $1.5B at $18B
items.summary: Led by Jane Street on 28 September, up from $7.5B about two months earlier. The asset-light hosting model is the one closest to what Kona could serve.

items.headline: Nscale files to go public
items.summary: S-1 filed 18 September seeking up to $3B. Contract value is $103.4B but only about 5% of contracted GPUs are energized.

items.headline: Crusoe raises $3.9B at $30.9B
items.summary: Series F on 17 September with Nvidia participating. More than 6 GW contracted and more than 1 GW operating.

items.headline: CoreWeave reports short contracts at about $40M per MW
items.summary: Three to six month contracts signed in Q3 priced at about $40M per MW annualized. The same day it announced a $3B convertible and a share sale programme.

items.headline: Cipher adds a second lease at Barber Lake
items.summary: A 10-year lease with an AI lab signed 25 September takes the site above $9B over 20 years. Cipher bears the first $359M of cost overruns.

items.headline: Hut 8 closes project debt near 6.1 to 6.2%
items.summary: $3.25B and $4.25B of investment-grade project financing plus a $1.07B revolver closed 24 September, backed by Google-supported and investment-grade leases.

items.headline: Anthropic prospectus shows at least $518B of compute obligations
items.summary: Reported 29 September. Spread across six partners over a decade, with some capacity cancellable on 90 days' notice.

items.headline: Argentina reportedly requires large loads to bring new generation
items.summary: Energy Secretariat Resolution 264/2026, effective 25 September, is reported to require new loads of about 80 MW or more to source at least 80% of energy from new generation. Single source; confirm in the Boletin Oficial.

items.headline: EXIM signs framework of up to $7B for Argentina
items.summary: Signed 23 September, covering energy, minerals and digital connectivity through 2027. No data center borrower named.

items.headline: Argentine country risk reaches 2026 high
items.summary: The spread hit 641 bps on 28 September on reserve and 2027 financing concerns.

kona: Two Argentine items matter most. A reported energy resolution now makes large new loads bring their own generation, which favours Kona's model, and EXIM signed a framework of up to $7B that includes digital connectivity. Against that, country risk hit its 2026 high and Stargate Argentina is still only a letter of intent.
title: Baseline: the two weeks to 4 October 2026
